faq.q: Where are Aitropolis's offshore development centers located?
a: Aitropolis operates dedicated offshore development centers in Islamabad, Pakistan, and Singapore, giving clients coverage across South Asia and APAC timezones alongside our Dubai and London studios.

faq.q: What engagement models are available for offshore teams?
a: Three models: Dedicated Team (a fixed team of engineers working exclusively on your product, managed by Aitropolis), Staff Augmentation (individual engineers embedded directly in your existing team and processes), and Project-Based Development (a scoped deliverable with a fixed timeline and outcome).

faq.q: How are engineers vetted before joining a client team?
a: Every engineer goes through technical screening, live coding assessment, and a communication/culture-fit interview before being presented to a client. Only pre-vetted engineers are placed on client engagements.

faq.q: Do offshore teams work in our timezone?
a: Yes. Teams align their working hours to overlap with your core hours, and our follow-the-sun model across Dubai, London, Islamabad, and Singapore means someone from your extended team is reachable close to around the clock.

faq.q: Who manages quality and delivery for offshore engagements?
a: Aitropolis provides full management oversight - a delivery manager, code review standards, sprint cadence, and reporting - so offshore capacity behaves like an extension of your team, not a black box.
